title: Jack Content Operators and the Deformed ${\mathcal W}_{1+\infty}$ Algebra
summary: Frenkel and Wang obtained a representation of the Virasoro algebra by commuting Goulden's cut-and-join operator with the Heisenberg generators. A vertex-operator construction by Lascoux and the author extends this representation to $\mathcal W_{1+\infty}$ by means of differential operators whose eigenvalues are the power sums of the contents of a Young diagram. We develop a Jack deformation in the spherical degenerate double affine Hecke algebra and its stable limit.
